title: PhD Research Fellow in Human Thermal and Cardiovascular Physiology
description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, Faculty of Health and Social Sciences (FHS), has a vacancy for PhD Research Fellow in Human Thermal and Cardiovascular Physiology

A fully funded three-year PhD position in  Human Thermal and Cardiovascular Physiology is available at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL). The position is part of the research project ThermRisk: A Personalized Digital Human Model for Predictive Thermal Risk Assessment.

ThermRisk is a collaborative project between three faculties at HVL: the Faculty of Health and Social Sciences (FHS), the Faculty of Education, Arts and Sports (FLKI) and the Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences (FTMS).

The Research Fellow will be affiliated with the Department of Health and Function under FHS. The candidate will also be part of the research group Sport, Health and Function and will work in the Human Health and Performance Laboratory.

The PhD Research Fellowship is a three-year fixed-term position. The Research Fellow will follow the PhD programme Health, Function and Participation and must apply for admission to the programme within three months of commencement. 

Deductions may be made in the appointment period for any previous recruitment periods.

The PhD Research Fellowship is a recruitment position intended to contribute to an active research environment at HVL.

The intended start date is 01.05.2027. The place of work is Campus Kronstad in Bergen.


About the project

The overarching research project ThermRisk: A Personalized Digital Human Model for Predictive Thermal Risk Assessment focuses on developing a computationally efficient digital twin for individuals exposed to extreme temperatures, enabling real-time prediction of thermal profiles and associated health risks. 

Together with supervisors, the PhD Research Fellow, will contribute to the finalization of the test protocol and will be responsible for collecting physiological data that provide information on changes in core temperature and the influence of relevant physiological variables during exposure to varying thermal environments. The Research Fellow will collaborate closely with a parallel PhD Research Fellow (see separate announcement) with a background in computational thermal physics, who will use the experimental data to develop a computational model / digital twin of the human body.

Relevance and Innovation
The project addresses a central knowledge gap in human thermoregulation under extreme thermal exposure and will lay the foundation for the development of personalized predictive tools for thermal health risk assessment. As a PhD Research Fellow, you will have a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge interdisciplinary research through close collaboration with the Sport, Health and Function research group and the Human Health and Performance Laboratory.

Principal Investigator (PI): Professor Boris Balakin (FTMS).

For questions about the position at the Faculty of Health and Social Sciences:
supervisor Merete Salveson Engeset, email: Merete.Salveson.Engeset@hvl.no
supervisor Ann-Katrin Grotle, email: Ann-Katrin.Grotle@hvl.no

More information about appointment in PhD Research Fellow positions can be found on HVL's website: Appointment to a research fellowship


Responsibilities

The main supervisor and candidate will together prepare a detailed plan for the research training, which will be linked to admission to the PhD programme in Health, Function and Participation.

  • Recruitment of study participants and data collection
  • Planning and execution of physiological testing in the Human Health and Performance Laboratory, including measurements such as VO2max, blood pressure, core and skin temperature, sweat measurements, and respiratory parameters.
  • Analysis of biological markers (in collaboration with bioengineering personnel where relevant).
  • Statistical analysis of quantitative physiological data
  • Close collaboration with a parallel PhD Research Fellow who will use physiological test data to develop a computational digital twin.
    Dissemination of research results through scientific publications and conferences.
  • A minimum of three first-author publications in peer-reviewed journals is required to be eligible to submit the PhD thesis.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

Criteria for employment in a Research Fellow position are set out in the Act relating to universities and university colleges https://lovdata.no/dokument/NLE/lov/2024-03-08-9

  • Completed Master's degree (120 ECTS credits) in human physiology, exercise physiology, sport science, or other fields directly relevant to the project, with a strong academic record (minimum grade B or better) in both the Master's degree overall and the Master's thesis. In cases of particularly relevant competence, an individual assessment may be provided as long as the requirements for admission to the PhD program are met
  • Master's students who expect to submit their Master's thesis by spring 2027 and who have achieved grade B or higher in previous courses are also welcome to apply. The Master's thesis must be assessed and approved no later than four weeks before commencement of the position
  • The successful candidate must meet the admission requirements for the PhD programme Health, Function and Participation. For more information, see: PhD Programme in Health, Function and Participation - Western Norway University of Applied Sciences
  • Solid background in physiology and demonstrated experience leading physiological testing, including responsibility for protocol execution, participant handling, and data quality in a laboratory setting
  • Good written and spoken proficiency in English is required
  • Good IT skills
  • Experience with quantitative research projects and physiological measurements in humans

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Knowledge of thermophysiology and human thermoregulation will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience leading or coordinating previous research projects
  • Relevant subject knowledge in cardiovascular physiology and related measurement and analysis techniques
  • Experience with processing quantitative data and conducting statistical analyses
  • Familiarity with measurement of core body temperature using established methods (e.g., ingestible telemetric capsules, rectal probes)
  • A record of scientific publications is considered beneficial
  • Good written and spoken proficiency in Norwegian or other Scandinavian languages, as participant recruitment, testing, and laboratory work will be conducted with Norwegian-speaking participants

 

Personal Qualities

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly across disciplinary boundaries (physiology ↔ computational modelling)
  • Responsible, structured, proactive, and flexible
  • Ability to work systematically and efficiently
  • Capacity for innovative thinking and follow-through
  • Ability to communicate and interpret research findings
  • Ability to work independently while contributing actively to the research group and broader academic environment
  • High ethical awareness in research work
  • Motivation to defend the doctoral thesis within three years

 

The following documentation should be uploaded:

  • A letter of application describing relevant experience and competence
  • CV with a complete list of academic publications
  • A scientific literature summary (maximum 3 pages) on the regulation and measurement of core temperature, factors influencing temperature regulation, as well as consequences of poor regulation
  • A reflection letter (up to 2 pages) on your motivation to undertake a PhD, including thoughts and perspectives on the project related to its thematic and methodological approach
  • Complete Master's thesis (if not yet finalized, a substantive excerpt suitable for assessment must be attached)

  • Diplomas and certificates

     


How to apply for the position:

Submit your application and CV by clicking on the button marked "søk stillingen" on this page. The application may be submitted in Norwegian or English. Applications cannot be sent by email to individuals at HVL.

Please note that applications will be assessed based on the information submitted to www.jobbnorge.no by the application deadline. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure that all relevant attachments are submitted by the deadline, including:

Applicants with a degree from a country other than Norway, need to attach a certified translation of the diploma and transcripts of grades to English or a Scandinavian language, in addition to the original documents, if the original is not in any of these languages. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application. Applications will be sent electronically to an expert committee. Based on the committee's recommendation, suitable applicants will be invited for an interview.

Applications cannot be sent by email to individuals at HVL.

Application for admission to the doctoral programme is to be submitted only after a possible appointment. Admission must normally be applied for within three (3) months after start-up, cf. Regulations for the degree of PhD at HVL § 2-4. More information about the PhD programme can be found here 

 


We offer:
  • Good occupational pension, insurance and loan schemes from The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Exciting academic environment with the possibility of competence enhancement and development
  • Opportunities for training within the working hours 

The Research Fellow position is compensated according to position code 1017 Research Fellow, start salary NOK 568 700,-

There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte)". Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences Bergen has therefore adopted a personnel policy objective to ensure that we achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons of various ethnic backgrounds.

Information about the applicant may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit.

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications. 


Contacts:

1) Associate Professor Merete Salveson Engeset,                              Tlf +47 55 58 55 73  

2) Associate Professor Ann-Katrin Grotle                                            Tlf +47 55 58 77 87 


Inclusion, challenging norms, collaboration

Homepage


Om arbeidsgiveren:

With about 16 500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og and Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.

We offer a broad range of educational programmes within the field of Health and Social Sciences as well as continuing education and post-graduate programmes, several master’s degrees and a doctoral program in Health, Functioning and Participation.

title: We are seeking a Project HSSEQ Manager!
description:
We are seeking a Project HSSEQ Manager for immediate start!

The Project HSSEQ Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating all Health, Safety, Security, Environment and Quality (HSSEQ) activities throughout the project lifecycle to ensure safe, compliant, and sustainable project delivery. The role provides strategic and operational HSSEQ leadership, promotes a strong safety culture, and ensures that project activities are executed in accordance with applicable legal requirements, company standards, client expectations, and industry best practices. The Project HSSEQ Manager works closely with project management, contractors, suppliers, and stakeholders to identify and manage risks, drive continuous improvement, prevent incidents, and deliver project objectives while safeguarding people, the environment, assets, reputation, and quality outcomes. The role shall provide practical and hands-on HSSEQ support throughout engineering, procurement, supplier fabrication, construction, installation, mechanical completion, commissioning and project handover activities.
The role is a mix between office-based work and site visits.

 

Duration: 01/10/2026 to 31/01/2027

 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain project-specific HSSEQ plans, procedures, and management systems aligned with company requirements, client expectations, and applicable regulations and contractual requirements.
  • Provide visible HSSEQ leadership and promote a proactive culture that prioritizes health, safety, security, environmental stewardship, and quality performance across all project activities.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, permits, standards, certifications, and contractual HSSEQ requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead the identification, assessment, and management of project risks and opportunities through effective hazard analysis, risk assessments, and mitigation measures.
  • Monitor HSSEQ performance through audits, inspections, observations, KPI reporting, and management reviews, ensuring timely corrective and preventive actions.
  • Advise project management and operational teams on HSSEQ matters and support decision-making to ensure risks are reduced to as low as reasonably practicable.
  • Lead incident reporting, investigation, root cause analysis, and lessons learned processes to prevent recurrence and drive continuous improvement in the project.
  • Manage emergency preparedness and response arrangements, ensuring adequate plans, training, and exercises are in place.
  • Ensure environmental impacts are identified, controlled, and minimized, supporting project sustainability objectives and regulatory compliance.
  • Support implementation of the Project Quality Plan and applicable project quality assurance and quality control requirements.
  • Coordinate HSSEQ and quality follow-up of suppliers, subcontractors and construction activities based on project criticality, contractual requirements and defined surveillance levels.
  • Review and follow up relevant supplier quality documentation, including Quality Plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), inspection and test records, NCRs and relevant manufacturing documentation.
  • Coordinate supplier surveillance and inspection activities, including inspection notifications and third-party inspection resources where applicable.
  • Coordinate HSSEQ training, competency development, and awareness programs for project personnel, contractors, and suppliers.
  • Manage contractor and supplier HSSEQ performance, including prequalification, monitoring, audits, and performance reviews.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with clients, regulatory authorities, contractors, and other key stakeholders regarding HSSEQ matters.
  • Prepare and present HSSEQ reports, performance metrics, and improvement recommendations to project and senior management.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and ensure lessons learned are captured and integrated into project execution and future business activities.
  • Support achievement of project objectives by balancing HSSEQ excellence with schedule, cost, quality, and operational requirements.
  • Support relevant regulatory and conformity-assessment activities in coordination with the responsible Engineering, Quality and certification functions.

Knowledge/Skills Required:

  • Thorough knowledge of HSSE and Quality standards, such as ISO 14001, 45001 and 9001
  • Solid understanding of the drivers for HSSEQ performance and culture
  • Understanding of Project Management, including risk management
  • Fluent in English - verbal and written, and can use English as a working language

Qualifications:

  • More than 5+ years of relevant experience from industrial projects or other relevant areas
  • Demonstrated experience from complex industrial projects involving supplier fabrication and/or construction activities.
  • Experience with quality assurance, surveillance, and control
  • LEAN experience and mindset are advantageous
  • Practical experience with both HSE and Quality-related responsibilities.
  • Experience with start-ups would be considered a plus

Folk can offer:

  • Good long-term opportunities with our clients
  • Individual and adapted follow-up while on assignment
  • Good career development opportunities in an interesting and innovative sector
  • Competitive terms and conditions

Social events and pleasant tokens of appreciation throughout the year
We see possibilities in your competence!
In Folk, we work in accordance with our values: ethical, personal, enthusiastic and flexible.

Since the establishment in 2004, Folk AS has assisted Norwegian and international companies by selecting and recruiting skilled people within technical and administrative disciplines – for project-based, temporary and permanent positions 
This is what we are good at – here lies our expertise.
Our values are: ethical, personal, committed and flexible.

title: Vi søker servicemedarbeider i helse og omsorg
description:
Vil du ha en meningsfull jobb der du bidrar til en tjeneste med orden, struktur og god atmosfære for ansatte, beboerne og deres pårørende?

Hva vi ser etter

Du kan gjerne ha erfaring fra renhold, kjøkken, hotell, butikk, lager, logistikk, service, helse eller annet praktisk arbeid. Formell helsefaglig utdanning er ikke nødvendig.

Det viktigste er at du er:

  • rolig, tålmodig og respektfull

  • selvstendig, pålitelig og ansvarsfull

  • praktisk anlagt og glad i orden

  • fleksibel og lærevillig

  • trygg i møte med mennesker

Mange av beboerne har langtkommen demens, og det er derfor viktig at du møter dem med ro, tålmodighet og respekt. Vi ønsker at du har gode norskkunnskaper.

Arbeidstid

Vi har behov for medarbeidere på ulike tidspunkt gjennom uken; på kveld og helg, evt. også dagtid året igjennom. Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidsoppgaver avtales ut fra behov og hvordan du best kan bidra i rollen.

Søknad

Fortell oss gjerne i søknaden hva du har erfaring med, hvilke oppgaver du kunne tenke deg og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi oppfordrer alle interesserte til å søke. Ikke vær redd for om du ikke treffer alle punktene. Vi er nysgjerrige på hva du kan bidra med.

Før tiltredelse: Godkjent og gyldig politiattest nyere enn 3 måneder. Negativ MRSA og tuberkulose-test. Taushetserklæring fylles ut første dag og gjelder også etter endt arbeidsforhold.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Elverhøy bokollektiv og Sagtomta bokollektiv (langtidsplass i institusjon for personer med demens og personer med skjermingsbehov) søker praktiske- og serviceinnstilte medarbeidere som kan avlaste helsepersonellet med oppgaver som ikke krever helsefaglig utdanning.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Arbeidsoppgavene tilpasses erfaringen din, hva du trives med og behovet på avdelingen. Du trenger derfor ikke kunne eller utføre alle oppgavene:

  • Tilberede og servere måltider, mating

  • Renhold og forefallende kjøkkenoppgaver før og etter måltider

  • Renhold av møblement inne/ute og hjelpemidler

  • Vanne blomster, støvtørking og avfallshåndtering

  • Klargjøring av rom mellom pasienter og mellom vaktskift

  • Orden og forefallende oppgaver på vaskerom

  • Håndtering og rydding av tekstiler/ bekledning

  • Orden og varepåfylling på lager

  • Logistikk: Hente og levere post, blodprøver, annet

  • Bistå kollega med å følge beboere til og fra aktiviteter

  • Bistå å være en trygghet for beboerne i fellesstua


Vi tilbyr

  • En tilpasset rolle basert på din kompetanse

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Muligheter for fast ansettelse etter prosjektets slutt

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vinn Hallingdal AS er rekrutteringspartner for Nesbyen kommune:

Nesbyen kommune Helse og omsorg

Nesbyen kommune er hjertet i Hallingdal, og ligger mellom Oslo og Bergen i Buskerud fylke. Kommunen har ca. 3 300 innbyggere, hvorav 2 100 innbyggere er bosatt i de sentrumsnære områdene. Det er et stort antall besøkende til kommunen som følge av store hytteområder.

Barnehagedekningen er god, vi har en av Norges beste grunnskoler og det er et variert skoletilbud innen videregående utdanning og fagskoler i Hallingdal. I kommunen er det et mangfold av frivillige organisasjoner for alle aldersgrupper og interesser. Mulighetene for en aktiv fritid er mange både innen idrett, friluftsliv og kultur (www.nesbyen.no). Kommunen er en av Norges mest attraktive sykkeldestinasjoner (www.trailhead.no). Med Bergensbanen og Rv. 7 som fartsårer, er kommunen lett tilgjengelig.

title: Cyber Security Manager
description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Through strong engineering expertise, cutting-edge technology, and close collaboration, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment where talent can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make a difference.

VARD Electro is a leading supplier of maritime electrical systems, automation, integration, and energy solutions for vessels operating worldwide. With a strong focus on innovation, digitalization, and sustainability, we develop advanced technologies that help our customers improve efficiency, safety, and environmental performance. As part of the VARD Group, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to shape the future of the maritime industry.

We are currently looking for a Cyber Security Manager to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

The Cyber Security Manager will be responsible for cyber security governance, compliance, and product security across Vard Electro's portfolio. You will drive our cyber roadmap, ensure compliance with industry regulations, and contribute to the development of secure products and cyber-related services.

 

  • Own and maintain Vard Electro's cyber security roadmap.
  • Ensure compliance with IACS UR E26/E27, IEC 62443, EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and other relevant standards, laws, rules and regulations.
  • Lead Cyber Type Approval and cyber certification activities with classification societies.
  • Define and manage cyber security requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support Product Managers and development teams in implementing secure-by-design principles.
  • Drive supplier and supply chain cyber security requirements.
  • Identify and develop new cyber security products, services, and commercial offerings.
  • Lead and develop the Cyber Security team.
  • Potentially assume product management responsibility for future cyber security products and services
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with cyber security in IT and/or OT environments.
  • Knowledge of maritime cyber security requirements and regulations.
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and IACS E26/E27.
  • Experience with cyber risk assessments, secure product development, and certification processes.
  • Experience with team management

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment will require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strategic and business-oriented mindset.
  • Analytical and structured.
  • Self-driven team player with leadership capabilities.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with Social by VARD you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

6264 Tennfjord

Vard Electro is a globally recognized and trusted provider and advisor of marine electrical systems. Established in Norway in 1997, Vard Electro has today approx. 900 employees based in Norway, Romania, Brazil, Singapore, India, Italy, UK, Canada, USA and Vietnam, and operating worldwide.

In close cooperation with the customer, Vard Electro offers ­effective and environmentally friendly solutions with a focus on optimization of the operational performance. title: Glad i aktiviteter og ønsker en variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag? Da kan du ha kommet rett sted!
description:
Først litt om meg:

Jeg er 59 år gammel mann som har leddgikt. Det betyr dessverre at jeg ikke får gjort alle de tingene jeg kunne tenke meg å gjøre i hverdagen. Men, det som er umulig for meg alene blir plutselig veldig mulig med litt hjelp. Jeg søker en person som kan hjelpe meg de praktiske tingene i hverdagen som å rydde, vaske og handle. Jeg trenger også bistand når jeg har dårlige dager hvor jeg gjerne trenger støtte for å ta en varm dusj, eller fylle varmeposer.

Samtidig er det kanskje vel så viktig at du også har «drive» og eventyrlyst, slik at jeg også får gjort aktiviteter utenfor hjemmet. Jeg har blant annet en nydelig hund som dessverre får for lite trim. Siden jeg har problemer med å gå lengre distanser, benytter jeg meg av rullestol. Et sterkt ønske er derfor å kunne gå på turer i grønne omgivelser slik at både jeg og hunden min Rocky får stimuli. Trening i basseng er annet punkt i min kalender hvor jeg gjerne skulle hatt med assistent. Videre har jeg et bredt spekter av interesser. Jeg elsker film og dokumentarer, reise, fisking og matlaging. Dersom du også er matinteressert så er det en kjempebonus. Jeg har også en flott Mercedes Vito (HC) stående i garasjen. Ettersom jeg ikke har sertifikat lenger er derfor flott om du har det, slik at den kan benyttes for å komme seg rundt. Den er for øvrig veldig lettkjørt. 

Som person er jeg rolig og balansert, og når vi blir bedre kjent håper jeg at vi kan bygge en vennlig og tillitsfull relasjon. Respekt og god kommunikasjon er derfor veldig viktig. Er du en iniativrik person er jeg også lydhør for nye idéer.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Helst over 23 år
  • Relativt fleksibel, med mulighet til å arbeide kveld og helg
  • Sertifikat (klasse B)
  • Snakker og skriver godt norsk
  • Pålitelig og punktlig
  • Lærevillig og tålmodig 

Vi tilbyr :

  • En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag
  • God opplæring
  • Stilling i et givende yrke
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn


Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere etter behov og kan blant annet omfatte:

  • Rydding og organisering i hjemmet
  • Rengjøring og annet husarbeid
  • Handling og praktiske gjøremål
  • Lufting og stell av hund
  • Bistand ved personlig stell ved behov
  • Følge til aktiviteter og avtaler
  • Hjelp til bassengtrening og andre fritidsaktiviteter
  • Matlaging og hjelp på kjøkkenet
  • Andre forefallende oppgaver i hverdagen

Du trenger ikke å ha erfaring fra BPA fra tidligere. Det viktigste er at du er pålitelig, lærevillig og har et ønske om å bidra til en god og aktiv hverdag.


Arbeidsstedet vil være i Rådal. Arbeidstiden vil variere og kan omfatte dag-, kvelds- og helgevakter. Dersom du føler deg truffet anbefaler jeg deg å søke omgående, ettersom vi vil ta kontakt med kandidater fortløpende. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

title: Hyggelig familiemann (41) søker tilkallingsassistenter til arbeid på dagtid!
description:

Jeg er en 41 år gammel mann som bor i en kjekk leilighet i Sandnes. Jeg deler leiligheten med min samboer, datter (11 år) og katten vår. Jeg sitter i rullestol og har sterkt nedsatte krefter i armer, hender og bein på grunn av sykdommen min. Jeg trenger derfor hjelp til alle praktiske gjøremål og har derfor fått innvilget BPA – brukerstyrt personlig assistanse.

Det er en ny og spennende erfaring for meg å ha assistent, men jeg ser fram til å bli kjent med deg og utvikle et godt samarbeid. Jeg trives godt med å jobbe sammen med andre, så dette kan fort gå veldig bra. Jeg er utdannet og jobber som lærer fra hjemmekontoret mitt noen timer i uka. Det er derfor viktig at du kan jobbe selvstendig, men med tilstrekkelig veiledning fra meg når det er nødvendig.

 

Stilling: Jeg har behov for tilkallingsassistenter som kan jobbe ved fravær og ved skoleferier.

Husarbeid

Matlaging

Assistanse til personlig stell ved behov

Assistanse med påkledning

Assistere i fysioterapiøvelser 

Assistanse ved toalettbesøk

Kjøre meg til lege/sykehus og annen oppfølging ved behov

Være med på turer ut til handling eller annet

 

Jeg søker deg som kan være mine armer og bein når jeg trenger det. Det er et pluss om du liker å lage mat og kan jobbe selvstendig. Også fint at du er positiv, løsningsorientert og tåler litt galgenhumor. Jeg ser fram til å møte deg!

w tym przygotowywanie projektów decyzji administracyjnych w zakresie określonym

za gospodarowanie odpadami komunalnymi oraz innych decyzji przewidzianych przepisami
ustawy o utrzymaniu czystości i porządku w gminach.
4) Weryfikowanie deklaracji o wysokości opłaty za gospodarowanie odpadami komunalnymi,
w tym analiza danych zawartych w deklaracjach oraz podejmowanie czynności
wyjaśniających w przypadku stwierdzenia nieprawidłowości.

przestrzegania przez właścicieli nieruchomości obowiązków wynikających z przepisów prawa
oraz aktów prawa miejscowego.
7) Kontrola prawidłowości realizacji umów zawartych z podmiotami odbierającymi odpady
komunalne, w szczególności w zakresie wykonywania usług odbioru i zagospodarowania
odpadów.
8) Sprawowanie nadzoru nad realizacją zadań powierzonych podmiotom odbierającym odpady
komunalne, w tym monitorowanie prawidłowości i terminowości realizacji usług.
9) Prowadzenie czynności kontrolnych wobec podmiotów wpisanych do rejestru działalności
regulowanej w zakresie odbierania odpadów komunalnych, zgodnie z obowiązującymi
przepisami.
10) Przygotowywanie dokumentacji związanej z prowadzonymi kontrolami, sporządzanie notatek,
protokołów, wystąpień oraz innych dokumentów wynikających z zakresu realizowanych

title: Organizator/ka Pomocy Społecznej
description:
Zakres obowiązków: OGÓLNY ZAKRES PODSTAWOWYCH OBOWIĄZKÓW:
1. Kierowanie  zespołem do spraw realizacji zadań z zakresu pomocy społecznej, organizowanie pracy podległych pracowników socjalnych oraz nadzór i kontrola nad rzetelnością, jakością i zgodnością ze stanem faktycznym i prawnym sporządzanych przez nich dokumentów.
2. Realizowanie innych zadań z zakresu pomocy społecznej wynikających z potrzeb gminy, w tym tworzenia i realizacja programów rządowych pomocy społecznej mających na celu ochronę i poprawę życia osób, rodzin i grup społecznych.
3. Prowadzenie analizy wykorzystania środków przychodzących z budżetu i innych będących w dyspozycji jednostki.
4. Kontrolowanie prawidłowości i rzetelności prowadzonych przez pracownika socjalnego rodzinnych wywiadów środowiskowych oraz ich zatwierdzanie.
5. Organizowanie udzielania świadczeń pomocy społecznej - pieniężnej, w naturze i usługach.
6. Współdziałanie w sprawach świadczeń pomocy społecznej z działem księgowości.
7. Współpraca przy opracowywaniu planów ośrodka z zakresu pomocy społecznej.
8. Nadzór nad merytorycznym i terminowym przygotowywaniem dokumentów, planowania i sprawozdawczości.
WARUNKI PRACY:
1. Pełny wymiar czasu pracy - 1 etat.
2. Przewidywany termin rozpoczęcia pracy po rozstrzygnięciu naboru.
3. Obiekt Centrum Usług Społecznych w Mikołowie przy ul. Kolejowej 2 jest przystosowany dla osób niepełnosprawnych ruchowo.
4. Praca przy monitorze ekranowym, praca w terenie.
5. Praca obarczona odpowiedzialnością, związana z samodzielnym organizowaniem pracy komórki organizacyjnej centrum.
Wskaźnik zatrudnienia osób niepełnosprawnych:

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med et førende globalt rejse- og turismebrand

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

Schema Evolution & Migrations:

Data Quality & Documentation:

NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist i Lissabon Portugal
description:
Er du passioneret omkring digital markedsføring og har erfaring med at optimere online kampagner? Vi leder efter en dygtig og analytisk Digital Marketing Specialist til at blive en del af vores internationale team i Lissabon!

Dine ansvarsområder vil inkludere:

  • Implementere optimeringsløsninger og strategier for vores højværdi-kunder.

  • Annoncering på sociale medier, primært via Google Ads.

  • Udarbejdelse af keyword-pakker, budstrategier og budgetforslag.

  • Udvikle ekspertise i Googles produkter ved hjælp af optimeringsteknikker, herunder Google Search Network (GSN), Mobile og YouTube.

  • Analysere data og tendenser for at skabe meningsfulde indsigter og rapportere på centrale KPI’er.

Vi søger dig, som har:

  • Minimum 12 måneders erfaring med annonceringsoptimering (Google Ads foretrækkes, men erfaring med Meta Ads, Instagram Ads og LinkedIn Ads er også relevant).

  • En struktureret tilgang, stærke analytiske evner og lyst til at arbejde i et internationalt miljø.

  • Gode kommunikationsevner på engelsk (skriftligt og mundtligt).

Vi tilbyder:

  • Hybrid arbejdsmodel (2 dage om ugen på kontoret).

  • Kontor i det kreative og moderne LACS Anjos i Lissabon.

  • Relocation-pakke og støtte til at få NIF og NISS (for kandidater der flytter til Portugal).

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring, inkl. tandlæge- og familieplan.

  • Livsforsikring.

  • En arbejdsplads hvor udvikling, fællesskab og innovation vægtes højt.

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Send din ansøgning og CV til LB@jobsqd.com – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

  • Kontor i det kreative og moderne LACS Anjos i Lissabon.

  • Relocation-pakke og støtte til at få NIF og NISS (for kandidater der flytter til Portugal).

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring, inkl. tandlæge- og familieplan.

  • Livsforsikring.

  • En arbejdsplads hvor udvikling, fællesskab og innovation vægtes højt.

title: TRABALHADOR DE LIMPEZA EM ESCRITÓRIOS, HOTÉIS E OUTROS ESTABELECIMENTOS
description:
Principais funções:

Efetuar a limpeza, higienização e organização dos espaços, incluindo quartos, casas de banho, áreas comuns e zonas de apoio;
Proceder à desinfeção dos espaços e equipamentos, cumprindo as normas de higiene e segurança;
Recolher e acondicionar adequadamente os resíduos;
Efetuar a lavagem, tratamento, organização e arrumação de roupas, quando necessário;
Manter os espaços devidamente organizados, limpos e em condições adequadas de utilização;
Apoiar na preparação e organização dos espaços destinados às atividades dos utentes;
Acompanhar e prestar apoio aos utentes nas atividades quotidianas, promovendo a sua autonomia, bem-estar e integração;
Apoiar os utentes nas deslocações, refeições e outras necessidades do quotidiano, sempre que necessário;
Prestar apoio na distribuição de refeições, lanches, produtos de higiene, vestuário e outros bens;
Acompanhar os utentes em pequenas deslocações ou atividades, de acordo com as orientações da equipa técnica;
Observar e comunicar à equipa técnica situações relevantes relacionadas com o estado, comportamento ou necessidades dos utentes;
Contribuir para um ambiente seguro, acolhedor, organizado e respeitador;
Colaborar com os restantes elementos da equipa, cumprindo as orientações e procedimentos internos da MAPS;
Zelar pelo bom uso e conservação dos materiais, equipamentos e instalações;
Cumprir as normas de higiene, segurança, confidencialidade e proteção dos utentes.

Objetivo da função:
Garantir a manutenção de espaços limpos, higienizados e organizados, assegurando simultaneamente um acompanhamento próximo e humanizado dos utentes, contribuindo para o seu bem-estar, segurança, dignidade e autonomia.

title: Italian-Speaking Technical Support Specialist (m,f) : Drone (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start: 03.08. or 01.09.26

We are partnering with a global technology company to recruit Italian-speaking Technical Support Specialists for a new project based in Italy.

In this role, you will provide professional technical assistance and customer support to users of cutting-edge camera drones. You will guide customers through troubleshooting, product usage, and problem resolution while ensuring an excellent overall experience. This is a great opportunity to work in a fast-paced, international environment with the latest technology.

Your Role
Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat in Italian.
Troubleshoot and resolve product-related issues with camera drones.
Assist customers with setup, functionality, and maintenance guidance.
Educate users on features, firmware updates, and common usage issues.
Log and manage cases accurately in internal systems.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to escalate complex technical problems.
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through timely and professional communication.

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Italian (C1 level)
Basic knowledge of English for internal communication
Previous experience in technical support, IT, or electronics is preferred
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, international environment
Interest or experience in drones, consumer electronics, or related technology is a plus

The Offer
Full-time position with a structured onboarding and paid training
Hybrid working model (office + remote) depending on operational needs
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Career development opportunities within an international tech company
Work in a collaborative, international team and gain exposure to cutting-edge technology

title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

title: Cuisinier (H/F)
description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Team Leadership & People Development

description:

Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.

At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.

Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
description:
Umývate riad a udržiavate čistotu v kuchyni, aby ste sa naučili dôležitosti hygieny a organizácie. Pripravujete suroviny, čistenie a krájanie zeleniny, čím sa zlepšíte v kuchynských zručnostiach. Upratujete kuchyňu a zabezpečujete, že je vždy pripravená na ďalšie varenie. Dodržiavate hygienické a bezpečnostné predpisy (HACCP), takže sa naučíte, ako sa starať o bezpečnosť potravín. Po riadnom zaškolení sa samostatne staráte o prípravu raňajok, čo vám dáva možnosť ukázať svoje zručnosti. V prípade potreby a po zaučení zastupujete šéfkuchára. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, aby vyhovoval potrebám nášho tímu a zohľadňoval vašu pohodu. Typická pracovná doba je delená a to od 7:00 hod do 12:00 hod následne 16:00 hod až 21:00 hod (závisí od vyťaženia), pričom sa prispôsobuje aktuálnej prevádzke.
Výhody:Vychutnaj si chutné a kvalitné jedlá v hotelovej reštaurácii za výhodné ceny. V prípade vzdialeného bydliska nad 30 km od hotela poskytujeme ubytovanie 1 € noc. Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Uži si prácu v úspešnej reštaurácii, ktorá je známa svojou kvalitou a štýlovým prostredím. Ak máš záujem, pošli svoj životopis alebo nás kontaktuj osobne v Hoteli GOLFER , Kremnica. Tešíme sa na nového kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorý á bude s nami tvoriť príjemnú atmosféru pre našich hostí aj celý tím!

title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
description:
Hľadáme šikovného človeka do kuchyne, ktorý má chuť pracovať, učiť sa nové veci a byť súčasťou tímu, kde gastronómia nie je len práca, ale zážitok. V našej kuchyni budeš pracovať po boku šéfkuchára Xander Matias, ktorý pôsobil dlhé roky v zahraničí a prináša do Kremnice moderný pohľad na gastronómiu, disciplínu aj kreativitu. Čo bude tvojou náplňou práce? pomoc pri príprave jedál a surovín príprava šalátov, príloh, dezertov a jednoduchších jedál starostlivosť o čistotu kuchyne a pracoviska pomoc pri výdaji jedál počas servisu učenie sa nových techník a fungovania profesionálnej kuchyne spolupráca pri eventoch, svadbách a firemných akciách Koho hľadáme? človeka, ktorý sa nebojí práce a má prirodzený záujem o gastronómiu niekoho spoľahlivého, tímového a aktívneho prax nie je podmienkou — dôležitá je chuť učiť sa vhodné aj pre mladých ľudí alebo absolventov, ktorí chcú získať reálne skúsenosti ✨ Čo ponúkame? možnosť učiť sa pod skúseným šéfkuchárom stabilnú prácu v rodinnom hoteli príjemný kolektív a moderné pracovné prostredie zamestnaneckú stravu možnosť profesijného rastu prácu, kde vidíš výsledok svojej práce každý deň

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v oblasti informačných a komunikačných technológií
description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
