title: Test System Engineer
description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Test system Engineer to develop, maintain, and improve the automation systems used in our advanced testing facilities for power electronics and HVDC converter valves at the HVDC Test Center.

In this role, you will be responsible for PLC programming, HMI development, control system troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated test systems. You will also support preventive maintenance activities and ensure the reliability, availability, and safety of critical test equipment and infrastructure.

You will be part of High Voltage Direct Current in Ludvika. We develop, manufacture, and sell DC transmission systems worldwide. HVDC technology is used to transfer electrical energy over long distances, enable power transmission through subsea cables, and connect power grids operating at different frequencies.

This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden.

How you’ll make an impact

    Develop and maintain PLC-based automation and control systems for advanced HVDC test equipment, including MACH.
    Design and enhance HMI solutions to improve usability, efficiency, and operational safety.
    Diagnose and resolve automation, control, and communication issues across complex test environments.
    Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective actions to improve system reliability and performance.
    Support commissioning, upgrades, and lifecycle management of test and automation systems.
    Ensure high equipment availability through preventive maintenance and continuous improvement initiatives.
    Collaborate with engineering, software, and manufacturing teams to deliver robust automation solutions.
    Utilize CMMS and other digital tools to track maintenance activities, equipment performance, and improvement initiatives.
    Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulations, and industrial control system requirements.
    Maintain technical documentation and provide technical guidance on automation systems and test equipment.

Your background

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field.
    Hands-on experience with PLC programming, troubleshooting, and industrial automation platforms.
    Experience developing and maintaining HMI/SCADA solutions in industrial environments.
    Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Profibus, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, or OPC UA.
    Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, control system documentation, and instrumentation drawings.
    Experience troubleshooting automated systems and performing root cause analysis.
    Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
    Health care and wellness allowance​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
    Psychological support program​​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

title: Demand Planner
description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

For this position we are seeking a motivated and curious individual who is proactive, analytical, and organized. You are good at building relationships, comfortable challenging the status quo and can adapt quickly to a fast-paced work environment. Additionally, you should enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You will report to Johan Törnqvist, Demand Planning Manager.

About the role:

As a Demand Planner within Global Aftermarket Operations, you will work in a dynamic global environment and cross-functionally with sales, marketing, finance, product/part management, projects, quality and supply. Aftermarket plays a vital role in our future ambitions and is a key area of strategic investment. By developing services, spare parts, and customer-focused solutions, we create value long after the initial sale, helping customers get the most out of their products throughout their entire lifecycle.

Our demand planning is based on system generated statistical data-driven forecasts combined with market and product trends that need to be collected from various stakeholders such as sales, product management, quality, projects, etc. This means that collaboration and analytics skills are key. Our forecasting is also exception based driven meaning planning system generates alerts on a daily, weekly and monthly frequency for significant deviations between actual demand and forecasts.

Further key responsibilities:

    Responsible for generating global forecasts at article level for accessories and parts with 24-month rolling horizon and with high forecast accuracy.
    Configurate the system to provide the best statistical forecasts.
    Gather required market and product trends and information from different stakeholders such as Sales, Product/Part Management, Projects, Quality department, etc. to ensure top level forecast accuracy.
    Creating long-term relationships and co-operation with international colleagues within Husqvarna Group.
    Investigate forecast exceptions and determine appropriate actions.
    Ensuring accurate reporting, monitor and analyze of KPIs and take action to improve performance
    Generate and develop reports to analyze and share demand trends with different stakeholders along with reporting and analysis of data for preparing business decisions
    Lead global cross-functional meetings
    Actively contribute and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance higher forecast accuracy, streamline processes and increase efficiency within the demand planning process and planning systems.

Your skills and background

    Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, logistics, business administration or a related field.
    Experience in supply chain, forecasting processes and statistical modelling
    Advanced skills in Excel and excellent presentation and communication skills
    Fluent in English, both in speaking and writing
    Previous experience with demand planning from a global company and advanced global demand planning systems, e.g. Logility as well as experience from aftermarket is highly advantageous.
    Previous experience, knowledge and general curiosity about AI is advantageous.

Location:

This position will be placed in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, at least 4 days a week (80%), creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making.

Your application:

Please submit your application in English as soon as possible as we will review applications on an ongoing basis. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR.

For questions about the role, reach out to hiring manager Johan Törnqvist, at johan.tornqvist@husqvarnagroup.com.

For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to Talent Acquisition Partner Nina Hallin at nina.hallin@husqvarnagroup.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we will ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.    

Our culture is built on three core themes:  

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!  

Learn more about our culture here.

title: Operatör inom produktion till Epiroc i Fagersta!
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du arbeta i en modern produktionsmiljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och samarbete står i fokus? Vi söker nu en operatör till färdigställningsavdelningen i Fagersta.



Bli en del av vårt team



Hos oss blir du en del av Rock Drilling Tools-divisionen, som utvecklar och tillverkar produkter för bergborrning och bergförstärkning. På färdigställningsavdelningen ansvarar vi för det sista steget i produktionsprocessen, där vi säkerställer kvalitet, förstärker materialets egenskaper och förbereder produkterna för slutleverans.







Ditt uppdrag



Som operatör på färdigställningen ansvarar du för drift, operatörsunderhåll och kvalitetskontroller. Utifrån produktionsplaner hanterar du materialflödet och arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med ditt skiftlag för att säkerställa hög kvalitet, leveransprecision och kontinuerliga förbättringar i verksamheten.



Arbetsuppgifter:




    Kulbombning och vakuumblästring för att förstärka materialet och avlägsna restprodukter.
    Manuell och automatisk riktning för att säkerställa att produkterna uppfyller höga krav på rakhet och måttnoggrannhet.
    Målning och slutbehandling inför leverans.
    Kvalitetskontroller, mätningar och avvikelsehantering.
    Drift, övervakning och operatörsunderhåll av produktionsutrustning.



Genom rotation mellan arbetsstationer får du på sikt en varierad vardag och möjlighet att utvecklas inom flera delar av produktionen.





Profile description:

Din profil



Vi söker dig som trivs med att ta ansvar och bidra med initiativ och förbättringsförslag. Du har ett starkt säkerhetstänk där du ser det som en självklarhet att följa säkerhetsrutiner och agera vid risker. Du arbetar noggrant och kvalitetsmedvetet, med förmåga att upptäcka avvikelser och säkerställa att arbetet håller hög standard. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som tycker om att samarbeta med andra och bidra till teamets gemensamma resultat.



För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:




    Eftergymnasial utbildning, gärna med teknisk eller industriteknisk inriktning.
    Praktiskt handlag och gärna erfarenhet av maskiner, verktyg eller industriproduktion.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift, för att kunna ta del av säkerhetsinstruktioner, dokumentation och skiftöverlämningar. Kunskaper i engelska är meriterande.
    Grundläggande datorvana eftersom produktion och avvikelser rapporteras digitalt.



Meriterande




    Erfarenhet från tillverkande industri.
    Truckkort samt B-körkort









We offer:

Placering, arbetstider och omfattning



Tjänsten är placerad i Fagersta, Sverige. Arbetstiden är skiftlagd och omfattar dag-, kvälls-, natt- och helgarbete.



Detta är en visstidsanställning med omgående start till och med den 31 december, med möjlighet till förlängning.







Livet på Epiroc



När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:




    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.







Ansökan och kontaktinformation



Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 2/10 2026. Observera att ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.



Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.







För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta:



Ansvarig chef, Ronnie Bergner, ronnie.bergner@epiroc.com



Rekryteringsspecialist, Erika Örneus, erika.orneus@epiroc.com

title: Material modelling engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic Turbine Mechanical Integrity team as a Material Model Engineer! Imagine being at the forefront of innovation, where you will engage in the entire process—from test planning to the development and implementation of material models that are essential for our engineering team. You will collaborate closely with our colleagues in the materials laboratory, ensuring that your contributions directly impact our projects. Our team tackles a variety of tasks, including finite element (FE) analysis, alloy development, constitutive modeling, and methodology development, while also providing vital support to workshops, procurement, and service.



How You’ll Make an Impact



    Develop, implement, and enhance constitutive and life material models for high-temperature applications.
    Contribute to the development of methodologies and procedures for constitutive and life material modeling.
    Support development and technology projects by assessing, planning, and evaluating material testing.
    Provide assistance in response to inquiries from manufacturing and customers.



What You Bring



    A Ph.D. in Solid Mechanics or a related field.
    Extensive expertise in material modeling, backed by several years of experience and a solid theoretical foundation.
    Experience with FE analysis for lifing calculations, along with a strong understanding of relevant principles and methodologies.
    Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.
    A collaborative mindset paired with strong communication skills.



About the Team
You will be part of an experienced team with diverse backgrounds and responsibilities. We strive to support one another and build a strong technical knowledge base within the team. Our commitment to developing long-term competencies makes us an ideal environment for individuals eager to grow and advance their careers alongside us.



Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.



We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.



Who is Siemens Energy?



At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.



Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.



Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo



Our Commitment to Diversity



Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

title: Accounting Business Analyst
description:
We’re looking for an Accounting Business Analyst for a company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 9 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.



Accounting Business Analyst

We are seeking a highly experienced accounting specialists for a consulting assignment within a large-scale financial transformation initiative.

The role requires strong hands-on experience in accounting and reconciliation of financial records in a complex enterprise environment. You are expected to independently analyse, design and document financial business processes from multiple front-end systems, detail resulting accounting patterns, in a complex enterprise environment.

﻿

ART Initiative

The company is running an initiative called ART, Accounting and Reporting Transformation, with the objective of moving accounting functionality from several legacy accounting solutions to a new cloud-based solution.

Integration with other systems is ongoing, including business applications delivering accounting data, source systems, and downstream consumers of accounting and reporting information.

﻿

The initiative includes several agile teams working across IT development, integration, infrastructure, security, and business processes. The solution includes development of customized bank-specific functionality running on dedicated server instances in the Oracle sovereign cloud, updates to legacy systems, and configuration and integration of an accounting SaaS solution provided by Oracle.

﻿

Required Skills & Experience

Strong ability to analyse accounting, reconciliation and reporting requirements and translate them into process descriptions, accounting patterns and system requirements

Hands-on and broad accounting experience and confident in describing accounting scenarios, for example using T-accounts

Strong ability to train and coach end-users to confidently and efficiently use the resulting accounting solutions

Experience in planning, preparing and executing tests of financial processes and accounting solutions in a large, multinational enterprise

Experience with financial services, accounting, regulatory reporting, and other highly regulated business domains

Experience working in agile development teams and collaborating across application, integration, test, and business functions

Strong written and spoken English communication skills

﻿

Education

Master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field

Equivalent professional experience may be considered

﻿

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in integrating large scale and custom business applications using Oracle Financials Cloud or similar, comprehensive accounting system

Experience in Change Management, organizational transformation, and user training

﻿

Key Responsibilities

Analyse functional and non-functional requirements and translate those into accounting and configuration specifications

Translate business, accounting, reporting and reconciliation requirements into implementable system requirements

Support configuration, operation, and maintenance of an accounting solution based on Oracle Financials Cloud and other supporting financial solutions

Collaborate with business stakeholders, system architects, and development teams to clarify functional and non-functional requirements

Produce and maintain high-level and low-level design documentation and test-scripts

Support testing, deployment, release, troubleshooting, incident analysis, and remediation in non-production and production environments

Contribute to common accounting standards, reconciliation principles, and ways of working

Participate actively in agile ceremonies and cross-team planning

Share knowledge and provide solution guidance to other project team members when required

Training and coaching end-users in using the configured solution

﻿

Personal Attributes

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

High attention to quality, details and consistency

Ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership of deliverables

Mind-set to drive continuous improvements within areas of responsibility but also within the team

Structured and methodical approach to complex assignments

Pragmatic mindset and ability to balance long-term targets with delivery needs

Effective communicator with both technical and business stakeholders

Comfortable working across accounting, system, reporting, and operational boundaries

Collaborative and team-oriented, with experience from agile environments

Able to document and explain accounting solutions and business decisions clearly

Proactive in identifying risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities

﻿

This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Stockholm through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 9 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: Lead Project Leader - AWS AI
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 6456

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced AWS AI Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery and governance of Nordea’s AWS-based AI platform initiatives.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional delivery across AWS cloud foundations, AI platform capabilities, security, data and engineering. You will help establish governed, scalable and reusable services that enable AI use cases across Nordea, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory and operational requirements.

You will translate strategic AI and cloud ambitions into executable plans, coordinate dependencies across multiple technology domains and provide clear, transparent reporting to senior stakeholders.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead end-to-end delivery of AWS AI platform initiatives, from scope definition and planning through implementation, operational readiness and handover.
    Establish and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
    Coordinate delivery across cloud engineering, architecture, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform engineering and business teams.
    Drive the evolution of AWS cloud foundations required for scalable AI adoption, including landing-zone capabilities, deployment pipelines, runtime environments, connectivity and platform resilience.
    Enable reusable AWS AI services and platform components that support multiple AI use cases and teams across the organisation.
    Ensure alignment between business needs, AI use cases, platform capabilities, enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps.
    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
    Establish clear decision-making forums, delivery standards, operating models and reporting practices.
    Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and cross-domain dependencies, escalating when required to maintain predictable execution.
    Drive operational readiness, including support models, service ownership, resilience, security, cost management and transition to operations.
    Engage senior stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.



Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record of leading complex technology programmes in AWS Cloud environments.
    Strong experience in AWS platform governance, cloud operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.
    Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.
    Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.
    Strong understanding of AI enablement platforms, including Generative AI, large language models, agentic or orchestration frameworks and model lifecycle management.
    Experience coordinating delivery across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.
    Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones and delivery plans.
    Strong understanding of platform-oriented delivery, including shared services, reusable components, automated onboarding and self-service capabilities.
    Experience establishing governance frameworks, delivery standards and operating models for large-scale cloud transformations.
    Understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational excellence and cost-management principles.
    Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, facilitate decisions and influence cross-functional teams.
    Very good financial, resource, risk and dependency-management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
    Advanced presentation and reporting skills, particularly using PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in both written and verbal communication.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented attitude.

The role is specifically positioned around Nordea’s AWS AI platform rather than generic multi-cloud delivery. This is consistent with the planned AWS capabilities for enterprise-scale AI adoption and the current focus on a governed, scalable platform supporting AWS ecosystems.

What we offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

title: International Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management
description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Om rollen

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.



About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

  

Your role as a Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management

You will join Property Development and Construction Management. We are involved in all phases of project development, from early-stage feasibility studies and planning to project execution and completion. Our focus is on managing and addressing construction-related issues throughout the development process to ensure successful project delivery.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to participate in and support feasibility studies, including meetings and activities aimed at enabling efficient project delivery. You will also gain experience in later project phases, working alongside Construction Managers on tasks such as cost control, contractor management, risk management, and other construction-related matters.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain insight into the entire construction and development process and contribute throughout all project phases. Typical responsibilities may include participating in, and eventually supporting, Real Estate Developers in negotiations and project planning during the early stages of development. You will also assist Construction Managers in documenting project deficiencies and quality issues, and over time develop the ability to independently evaluate construction-related challenges and propose solutions under the guidance of experienced colleagues.



Your responsibilities:  

    Support Construction Managers with the documentation of construction-related defects and project issues
    Participate in technical drawing reviews to ensure compliance with project requirements and construction standards.
    Support real estate developers in managing construction-related matters during feasibility study phase and early-stage project development.
    Provide administrative support across construction and development projects
    Collaborate with internal teams and external contractors to support efficient project delivery.

Kravspecifikation

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Urban Development and Infrastructure, or a related field.
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

You should also recognize yourself in

    You are comfortable navigating different perspectives and balancing the interests of multiple stakeholders.
    You are proactive, curious, and eager to take initiative while maintaining a humble attitude and a willingness to learn.
    You are open-minded and receptive to new ideas, while also able to make sound decisions when needed.
    You have strong communication and collaboration skills and enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:

You will be working in the department Construction and Property Development and be located in Solna, Trollhättan or Gothenburg, (Sweden).

Ytterligare information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe.

title: International Trainee  Analyst Group Strategy
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. title: IT Support to Paradox Interactive!
description:
Step into a tech adventure with Padarox Interactive! A unique opportunity for a gaming enthusiast to dive into a diverse role, tackling everything from software wizardry to hardware magic. Join a team that values your passion for technology and offers a vibrant, inclusive culture.

About the role

Paradox Interactive is one of the premier game developers and publishers of strategy and management games on PC and consoles! In this position, you'll play a crucial role in providing day-to-day technical support to your colleagues in the organization. You together with a team of 10 will provide seamless support to 800 colleagues in multiple global offices.

Responsible for day-to-day technical support, your role includes troubleshooting hardware and software issues both on-site and remotely. You play a vital role in the smooth onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring the seamless integration of hardware, software, and other services. Additionally, you take charge of the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment, ensuring a conducive environment for smooth operations.

You are offered

    Great culture with social hours, board games, and quiz nights
    A great role to deepen your knowledge within tech
    A dedicated consultant manager from Academic Work who will support and coach you in your future career

Work tasks

    Configure and troubleshoot software for seamless operations both on site and remote  
    Install and set up new computers, addressing hardware issues  
    Provide remote support to offices globally, contributing to a smooth tech environment  
    Collaborate with the support team on projects for infrastructure scaling and updates  
    Ensure the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment

We are looking for

    Work experience in IT support/IT related customer service
    Has an interest in hardware and technology
    Good knowledge of English in both speech and writing as it is used in daily work

It is meritorious if you have

    

● Worked in onsite experience in IT support previously

● Prior experience in networking and/or PC hardware troubleshooting

● Gaming interest

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

    Service-minded
    Curious nature
    Problem solver
    Adaptable

Paradox value attitude and personality. They seek individuals with a positive mindset, knowledge of technology, and a genuine interest in providing top-notch service. It's also important that you thrive in a culture where they embrace diversity in cultures, geographies, and languages.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Junior Operative Purchaser
description:
Junior Operative Purchaser – Harnesses & Components

We are looking for a Junior Operative Purchaser to join a procurement organization within a fast-paced production environment in the Stockholm area. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in supply, sourcing or operational purchasing who enjoys working closely with suppliers, planning teams and project stakeholders.

🛒 About the role

As an Operative Purchaser, you will be responsible for placing purchase orders, following up deliveries and ensuring that materials and services are available according to production requirements and project milestones.

The role requires a structured and proactive approach, as you will manage several interfaces and need to respond quickly when priorities or delivery conditions change.

📋 Key responsibilities

    

Purchase materials and services based on planned requirements.

    

Place and manage purchase orders.

    

Expedite orders and follow up deliveries.

    

Obtain and follow up cost estimates.

    

Manage supplier invoices.

    

Provide ongoing feedback and status updates to relevant stakeholders.

    

Build and maintain supplier relationships.

    

Follow up supplier performance and delivery precision.

    

Support optimization of purchasing and material flows.

    

Collaborate closely with planning teams and different project functions.

🎯 Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has:

    

A Bachelor's degree or relevant professional experience within supply, sourcing or purchasing.

    

Previous experience within supply, sourcing or operational purchasing is highly advantageous.

    

Good understanding of purchasing within a supply chain and production environment.

    

Ability to independently follow up suppliers and drive activities to ensure good delivery precision.

    

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

    

A structured, proactive and solution-oriented approach.

    

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and changing production environment.

You are a team player who takes responsibility, acts proactively and maintains focus on delivery and overall objectives.

🔐 Security requirements

The position requires successful completion of a security vetting process in accordance with applicable security protection regulations. Depending on the required security classification, additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.

Location: Stockholm area Period: October 19, 2026 – December 31, 2027 Scope: Full-time, 100% Work model: On-site Extension: Good possibility of extension

title: Verkstadschef Lidköping
description:
Verkstadschef Lidköping

Placeringsort: Lidköping

Sverull är en ledande aktör inom industriservice, mekaniskunderhåll och produktförsäljning med spetskompetens inom elektromekanik, lager, transmissioner, tätningar, pumpar och elmotorer. Vi erbjuder hela kedjan från produktleverans till montage, underhåll och reparationer. Vi har filialer på 11 orter i Sverige med huvudkontor i Jönköping.

Sverull ägs av industrikoncernen Axel Johnson International. Som auktoriserad servicepartner till Xylem, Grundfos och Wilo och auktoriserad återförsäljare av SKFs produkter samt Value Provider till ABB kan vi erbjuda dig relevanta utbildningar inom pump, motor, transmission och lager.

Din roll

Som verkstadschef har du det övergripande ansvaret för serviceverksamheten i Lidköping. Idag har vi sju servicetekniker men vi är i ett expansivt läge med ytterligare rekryteringar planerade. Rollen innefattar bland annat budgetansvar, att leda och fördela arbetet på verkstaden mot uppställda mål, nyckeltal och KPI:er. Då tjänsten även innefattar personalansvar har du som verkstadschef en viktig roll i att upprätthålla en god sammanhållning i ditt team samt att säkerställa en god och säker arbetsmiljö. Verkstadschefen har också en viktig roll att stödja serviceteamet vid offertframtagande, samt hitta delar och komponenter och fakturering mot kund.

I rollen som Verkstadschef har man ett tätt samarbete med både kundsupport och sälj lokalt samt med övriga serviceverkstäder, verkstadschefer och andra centrala funktioner.

Verkstadschefen rapporterar till Operativ chef



Din profil

·       Meriterande med kunskaper inom våra huvudområden, lager, transmissioner, tätningar, pumpar och elmotorer

·      Meriterande med kunskaper inom miljö och arbetsmiljö området, ISO 14000 och ISO 45000.

·       Erfarenhet ifrån en tidigare roll innefattande ledarskap och/ eller erfarenhet från en maskinteknisk roll

·       God system- och datorvana

·       Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

·       B-körkort.

Vi tror att du som söker uppskattar frihet i din roll och motiveras av att driva projekt framåt, där du tar egna initiativ och gärna bidrar med nya idéer och perspektiv. Därtill motiveras du av att nå uppsatta mål och arbetar ständigt för att förbättras och utvecklas i din roll. Då tjänsten innefattar många varierande arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden är du som person noggrann och har förmågan att strukturera och prioritera bland dina uppgifter.

Är du personen vi söker?

Skicka ditt CV och Personliga Brev till Klas Nyström, Operativ chef

klas.nystrom@sverull.se Vid frågor, kontakta Klas på tel: 0770 221 403

title: Kyltekniker
description:
Welcome!

Bravida is a leading multi-technical service provider and is represented in more than 150 locations in Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland.

Bravida has around 10,000 employees working together. ·      Små till mellanstora montage av kyla

·      Kundkontakt

title: Project Manager  EPCM Industrial Projects
description:
Project Manager – EPCM Industrial Projects

Are you an experienced industrial project leader ready to align and coordinate technical disciplines toward a common goal? Do you want to be part of Sweden’s most exciting industrial ventures driving the green transition? Then we want to hear from you. We are expanding our team of EPCM Project Managers at COWI. Join us and take part in complex investment projects from idea to execution – often as the EPCM provider – where you’ll help shape the future of sustainable industry.

We work where the future of industry is taking shape

Combining deep technical expertise and project management excellence, we deliver end-to-end solutions – from feasibility studies and FEED to detailed design and support during construction and commissioning. Our key markets include refineries and petrochemicals, energy, water treatment, and the forest industry – sectors where the demand for sustainable solutions drives innovation and transformation. Our project methodology is rooted in PMBOK, with structured approaches to cost estimation, risk management, and multidisciplinary coordination following the EPCM modal.

Your role – Leading industrial EPCM projects

As a Project Manager, you’ll play a key role in delivering value to our clients – often working on site or in close collaboration with their project teams. You’ll lead projects across all phases: from planning, procurement, and design to implementation and handover. Your responsibilities include:

    Leading and coordinating multidisciplinary EPCM projects in accordance with contracts
    Ensuring timely delivery within budget and to the agreed quality
    Planning resources, tracking financials, and managing deviations
    Communicating effectively with all project stakeholders – both internal and external
    Managing risks, opportunities, and changes throughout the project lifecycle
    Working closely with clients and internal COWI experts in engineering, procurement, and construction

Locations: Stenungsund and Gothenburg

Interested? For more information, please contact:

Andreas Lindberg, Act. Head of Discipline Mobile: +46 70 810 47 66

At COWI, you’ll join a high-performing environment where you develop alongside some of the industry’s most skilled professionals – locally and globally.

title: Electronics System Engineer to Beyond Gravity Gothenburg
description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​



About Beyond Gravity

Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com



Your crew

Join a highly collaborative, cross-functional team at the heart of Beyond Gravity’s Electronics business. Working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Programs, Production and other functions, you will contribute to the development of satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products.

As an Electronics System Engineer, you will work at system and architectural level, providing system engineering expertise for electronics hardware systems, embedded processing systems and platform and payload solutions across development projects and series production programs in the satellite electronic solutions domain.

This is a role with significant development potential. You will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership, broaden your technical expertise and grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities over time.



Your mission

The Electronics System Engineer is responsible for:

    Take ownership of your scope and bring assigned tasks to completion, involving more senior colleagues when needed.
    Develop and maintain satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products at system and architectural level.
    Analyse and understand internal and external customer requirements and translate them into system-level requirements and technical solutions.
    Break down system requirements into subsystem and module requirements and establish corresponding design requirements.
    Develop technical concepts and system designs appropriate to customer and project needs, considering cost, time, quality, performance and technical feasibility.
    Perform and/or assess system-level analyses, including performance, radiation, structural, EMC, reliability, FDIR and HW/FPGA/SW interaction analyses.
    Coordinate development activities with other teams and disciplines to ensure complete and intended implementation of the system.
    Plan and execute your own activities, monitor progress against schedule and budget, and raise awareness of risks and blocking points.
    Support bidding and proposal activities through technical descriptions, concept work, cost and schedule estimates and risk and opportunity assessments.
    Contribute to continuous improvement of products, technologies, processes and ways of working, challenging established solutions where appropriate.
    Interact with customers, suppliers and external stakeholders within your area of responsibility and provide technical know-how to support successful project execution.
    Maintain and develop system-level documentation and ensure compliance with established development processes and standards.



Most important outputs:

    Robust and efficient system solutions that meet customer and project requirements.
    Successful delivery of system engineering activities within agreed scope, quality, schedule and budget.
    Continuous development of products, technologies and engineering methods.



Your story

We are looking for a technically curious and solution-oriented System Engineer with a strong interest in satellite electronics and system engineering. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently and enjoy finding solutions to complex technical challenges.

You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy working across disciplines, with the ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, customers and external partners. You are motivated by continuous learning and want to develop your expertise and responsibility over time.

This role is a great opportunity for someone with strong potential to grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities and, in time, a Senior System Engineer role.



Must-haves:

    M.Sc. in Electrical, Software or Aerospace Engineering, or corresponding experience.
    Experience or good knowledge in system engineering, electronics or embedded systems, preferably within the space industry.
    Understanding of requirements engineering, functional decomposition and system design.
    Ability to perform or assess system-level analyses and understand HW/FPGA/SW interactions.
    Ability to work independently, take ownership and deliver within agreed scope, schedule and budget.
    Strong collaboration and communication skills.
    Structured and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges and risk.
    Fluent English, written and spoken.



Nice to have’s:

    Experience with satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products or ground electronics.
    Knowledge of FPGA, hardware, RF, signal processing or embedded systems.
    Experience with tools such as MATLAB, DOORS, PSA, FMECA, DOSRAD or Reliability.
    Knowledge of ECSS, agile methods or model-based systems engineering.
    Experience with technical coordination, customer interaction or proposal work.
    Knowledge of product roadmaps and current technology trends.



Why Beyond Gravity



    To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
    You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
    We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!



🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​

​Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Work from Home: Norwegian-Speaking Customer Service Representative  Sikom
description:
Transcom is currently recruiting for our subsidiary, Xzakt, and we are looking for a Norwegian-speaking Customer Service Representative to join the team in Gävle, working from home anywhere in Sweden.

Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service while working alongside great colleagues in a modern office with hybrid work opportunities? Then you could be our next team member at Xzakt Gävle!

We are looking for a customer-focused and service-minded individual who enjoys helping people and has an interest in sales. At Xzakt, we believe your engagement and ambition should be rewarded with opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.

What We Offer

At Xzakt, you'll have the opportunity to develop your professional skills while growing both personally and professionally. We provide a paid onboarding and training program to ensure you have the knowledge and tools you need to succeed.

In addition, we offer:

    Work remotely from your own home
    Collective agreement and occupational pension
    Wellness allowance
    Rikskortet employee benefit card for savings on groceries and restaurant purchases
    Career development opportunities within a global company

About the Role

As a Customer Service Representative, you will provide support for our client, Sikom, handling incoming phone calls and emails from customers using heating control solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Providing technical support
    Answering invoice and billing questions
    Guiding customers to the products that best suit their needs
    Delivering an excellent customer experience through professional and solution-oriented service
    Identifying customer needs and recommending relevant products or services through consultative sales

You will have a high level of responsibility while always receiving support from experienced colleagues and clear processes. We work in a fast-paced environment where teamwork is key.

Position: Customer Service Representative (CSR)

Working hours: Scheduled weekdays between 08:00–16:00

Employment rate: 100% permanent contract, with 6month probation time

Employment type: Work from Home

Start date: 12th of October 2026

About You

We are looking for someone who is curious, communicative, and genuinely enjoys working with people. You are flexible, adaptable, and comfortable presenting different options and solutions to customers. You are patient, goal-oriented, and motivated by personal development and continuous learning.

To succeed in this role, you should have:

    Fluency in Norwegian, both spoken and written
    Fluency in English, both spoken and written
    Good technical understanding and interest in technology
    A completed high school diploma or equivalent
    Have a reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace suitable for working from home.

Previous experience in customer service and/or sales is considered an advantage but is not required.

About Xzakt

title: Driver & Mechanic - Uppsala
description:

We have our mechanical team, where you will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of our vehicles. This means keeping our scooters in top shape and provide strong support to our team on the ground. We also have our In field team, where you'll be utilising our vans to perform different tasks in the Uppsala area, making sure our operations runs as efficiently as possible. Here are some exciting tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist:

    

Ensuring the logistics of collecting and providing Voi scooters.⚙️

    

Searching for and collecting damaged scooters. 🛴

    

Battery replacement.🔋

    

Performing quick on-site repairs of the scooters.🔧

    

Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles.🔧

    

Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired. ♻️

    

Assisting with the acceptance, packaging, and provision of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse. 🔍

    

Supporting our on-site team as needed, whether it's identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces, or setting up fallen vehicles.🤝

A valid drivers license for Sweden

    

Fluency in english, both verbal and written

    

Previous experience with tools or mechanical practices

    

General familiarity with digital tools and applications

The ability to remain calm in stressful situations (such as difficult parking or traffic)

Why Voi?

    

Unlimited Voi rides

    

Pension 4,5%

    

Wellness contribution

    

Free digital meetings with medical service KRY

    

Employee Assistance Program via EuroAccident

    

Referral bonus program

Working at Voi is more than just a job; it's a personal Voiage where you'll grow as a professional and be part of a diverse team and culture that's committed to making a positive impact on society. In addition to this, you'll have the opportunity to:

    

Join Europe's leading micromobility company and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups

title: Technical Lead
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will take the technical lead across engineering activities in project assignments with lower engineering complexity. The role is set in a multidisciplinary engineering environment where design, quality, safety and execution need to align from early engineering through installation and commissioning.

You will help create structure across disciplines, make sure engineering work moves forward efficiently, and support the project with practical technical decisions. This is an interesting opportunity if you enjoy broad technical ownership and want to work close to both design and delivery.

Job Description

    You will coordinate engineering activities across disciplines and make sure work is carried out efficiently and in line with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements.
    You will evaluate, select and apply standard techniques, procedures and criteria to solve engineering tasks in conventional projects with limited complexity.
    You will use established solutions to move assignments forward and keep technical work on track.
    You may act as design authority within a specific engineering discipline and complete assignments in that area.
    You will collaborate with installation, commissioning and site teams to clarify issues, correct engineering errors and support smooth execution.
    You will provide technical support during commissioning and start-up activities.

Requirements

    Working command of the English language
    You have experience coordinating engineering activities across multiple disciplines.
    You can work with standard engineering techniques, procedures and established solutions in project environments.
    You are comfortable supporting installation, commissioning and site activities with clear technical guidance.
    You understand how to work in line with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Site Manager, Sweden-based projects, Nordec
description:
Nordec is one of the leading providers of steel structures and façade solutions in Northern Europe. We design, manufacture and install steel structures for demanding construction projects, ranging from industrial facilities and logistics centres to large-scale data centres and other landmark developments.

Barona is recruiting Site Managers on behalf of Nordec. The selected candidates will be employed directly by Nordec in a permanent position.

As Nordec continues to strengthen its presence in Sweden and across Northern Europe, we are looking for experienced Site Managers to lead installation works on demanding construction projects.

This is an opportunity for an experienced site professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with people leadership, customer collaboration and hands-on project execution. In this role, you will be at the heart of project delivery, ensuring that installation activities are completed safely, efficiently and according to agreed quality and schedule targets.

As a Site Manager, you will act as one of Nordec's key representatives on site. You will lead installation teams and subcontractors, coordinate daily site operations and work closely with customers, project management and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include:

    Leading and coordinating on-site installation activities

    Managing site teams and subcontractors

    Ensuring quality, safety, schedule, cost control and productivity targets are achieved

    Acting as the main on-site contact towards customers and stakeholders

    Monitoring project progress and reporting to the Project Manager

    Resolving operational challenges and supporting efficient project execution

The role requires sound technical understanding, strong leadership capabilities and the ability to maintain productive relationships with customers, partners and site personnel in a dynamic project environment.

What we are looking for

We are interested in professionals who have gained substantial experience in site management, construction management or related leadership roles within construction and industrial projects.

To succeed in the role, you have:

    Several years of experience in site management, project management or a comparable leadership position

    Proven ability to lead teams and coordinate multiple stakeholders in demanding project environments

    Strong understanding of construction processes, site operations and safety requirements

    Experience from large industrial projects, data centres or other technically demanding construction projects is considered an advantage

    Experience of cost control and budgeting

    Fluent English language skills, Swedish is considered an advantage

    A structured, proactive and solution-oriented way of working

    Willingness to travel according to project requirements

Why join Nordec?

Nordec offers the opportunity to work on some of the most technically demanding construction projects in Northern Europe. The company is involved in projects that combine engineering expertise, high-quality execution and international collaboration.

As a Site Manager, you will have a central role in project delivery and significant responsibility for driving successful outcomes on site. You will work alongside experienced professionals in an international environment where expertise, collaboration and practical problem-solving are highly valued.

The role offers long-term career opportunities within a growing organisation operating across several European markets and project sectors.

Applications will be reviewed during the recruitment process, and positions will be filled once suitable candidates have been identified.

This recruitment is conducted in cooperation with Barona. For further information regarding the position and the recruitment process, please contact Johnny Seijsing at Barona Sweden. Please note that, due to information security and GDPR requirements, we cannot accept applications by email or WhatsApp.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Location/Division Specific Information:

Olink, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease.

Job description

The Customer Care Specialist role offers you a place on a multi-faceted, dynamic, and rewarding team focused on delivering best-in-class support. We are looking for an experienced Customer Care Specialist to join our organization to support our internal and external customers when purchasing Olink products.

The Customer Care team is responsible for ensuring the journey of our customers’ experience with Olink is exceptional. You would be based in our Uppsala office and report to Manager, Customer Service based in the US.

A Day in the Life:

    Meet the challenges of a fast-paced environment, while maintaining a customer focus and strong level of professionalism.
    Ensure each transaction is processed within company guidelines, customer specifications and established Service Level Agreement.
    Use our ERP System, Salesforce and other applications to register and maintain customer account information, process orders and research inquiries.
    Provide communication to customers and Business Development Manager to confirm order, delivery, and invoicing.
    Proactively research delays, collaborate with supporting teams for resolution. Communicate all changes to customer and Business Development Manager.
    Investigate customer complaints and inquiries by collaborating with all supporting teams such as Sales, Support, Distribution and Finance for quick resolution.
    Monitor customer feedback from Satisfaction Survey, contact any unfavorable responses for resolution and report details.
    Answer inbound customer phone calls and inquiries, check voicemails and triage to correct team.
    Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement, collaborate with team and leader to build efficiencies.

QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES Education

    Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Qualifications - Experience, technical skills

    Proven success in a Customer Service role for 2+ years with a passion for building customer loyalty. If you have experience in a similar role within Life Sciences it´s an advantage.
    Documented experience in Microsoft Office and SalesForce programs and an ability to learn other software and ERP systems.
    Excellent language skills, both verbally and written, in English is mandatory.

Competencies -

Personal skills and abilities

As a person you should have strong organizational skills as well as the ability to communicate with both customers and internal stakeholders in a clear and friendly way. In this role it is crucial to be good at multitasking while keeping a strong customer focus and to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Last but not least at Olink we have a commitment to implementing feedback as a means to achieving individual and company performance goals.

Why Join Us?

At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career.

The final date to submit applications is the 27th of September 2026. The role could be filled prior to this deadline.

title: Senior Global Business & Pricing Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about transforming data into strategic insights that drive global impact? At Sandvik Business Area Machining, we’re looking for a Senior Global Business & Pricing Analyst to join our small and dedicated team.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping how we understand and act on data across our global operations. If you're ready to make a difference in an organization that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, this is the job for you.

About the job

In this role, you're responsible for delivering high-impact business reporting, data modelling, and analysis, with a strong focus on pricing processes and data. You support strategic planning, performance management, and operational excellence by turning complex business needs into actionable insights. Working closely with stakeholders across business units, finance, operations, and IT, you help ensure data-driven strategies align with organizational goals.

You develop and maintain dynamic reporting solutions and dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and accessibility across our organization. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, streamline reporting processes, and reduce redundancy by promoting automation and standardized practices. Through analysis of existing workflows, you initiate process enhancements and automated solutions that improve efficiency, strengthen data collection, and support global pricing analysis.

Job responsibilities

    Act as a subject matter expert in reporting systems, services and analytics.
    Data modelling & report and dashboard development.
    Drive continuous improvement in reporting, modelling, processes and tools.
    Support the implementation of new systems and services.
    Manage reporting lifecycle, ensuring data accuracy, access control and relevance.
    Provide training and communication on reporting tools and insights.
    Lead cross-functional and cross-regional analysis projects that inform strategic decisions.

Location and flexibility

The position is flexible within Europe.

Your profile

We're looking for someone with experience in business analysis, reporting, or consulting, with a strong background in pricing. A relevant university degree and proficiency in English, both verbally and in writing, is essential. Certifications in data analytics or visualization are a plus.

Your background includes:

    Proficiency in Microsoft technologies, particularly Power BI and Azure-based solutions.
    Experience with reporting and data warehousing solutions, dataset modelling, and dashboard development.
    An understanding of data integration from multiple sources.
    Experience developing dashboards and data models in large, multinational environments.

You’re a self-starter who thrives in a virtual, global work environment. With strong communication skills, you present complex data in a clear and compelling way. You bring a customer-focused mindset, collaborate effectively across teams and are capable of leading projects with minimal supervision. You think critically, solve problems creatively, and are always eager to learn and innovate. Additionally, your ability to influence, train others, and work across time zones makes you a valuable asset to our team.

Our culture

Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? Visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.

title: Group Manager - Product Development
description:
Silex Microsystems is looking for a passionate and driven Group Manager to lead one of our Product Development teams. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who’s willing to take the next step in their leadership career while working at the cutting edge of MEMS technology.

The Team 

The Product Development team picks up where the Sales team leaves off, collaborating closely with clients to transform innovative ideas into tangible products ready for production. Our mission is to ensure that we meet client expectations in the proof of concept and prototype production phase. With approximately 50 team members, including Product Managers, CAD Engineers, and Process Design Engineers, our team closely collaborates and exchanges expertise. 

The role

As Group Manager, you will build and lead a team of ambitious Product Managers at various seniority levels, with the ambition of growing the team to five to six members over time. At the same time, you will drive the development and launch of new products within key customer programs.

In the beginning of the role, you will also work as a Senior Product Manager, allowing you to stay close to the product and customer needs while establishing and developing the team.

A key part of your mission will be to ensure that the team thrives — both in terms of professional growth and in delivering high-quality, customer-focused results. You will be responsible for resource planning, supporting team members in their day-to-day work, and ensuring alignment with departmental goals, processes, and priorities.

You will also play a central role in the success of the team’s development programs, taking ownership of team performance, customer satisfaction, technical excellence and long-term profitability. As the first line of escalation, you’ll provide hands-on technical support when projects need extra attention, ensuring timely and effective resolutions.

Key Responsibilities

    

Lead and coach a team with direct-reporting engineers within Product Development.

    

Manage resource planning, goal setting, and prioritization.

    

Support team members both technically and commercially in their programs and ensure delivery excellence.

    

Drive professional development and foster a strong team culture.

    

Represent your team in internal forums and customer discussions.

    

Act as first escalation point for customer program challenges.

Time Allocation (Typical Monthly Distribution)

    

50% – Supporting the team’s customer programs.

    

30% – Leading your own customer programs.

    

20% – People management, planning, and team development.

Who You Are

You are an experienced leader with a strong background in project or program management and a passion for people development. You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment and enjoy working close to both customers and technology.

To be successful in this role, we believe you have:

    

5+ years of experience in project management, program management, or similar areas.

    

Solid experience in customer-facing roles, with a proven track record of building long-term client relationships.

    

Experience within MEMS integration and/or product development in a related industry.

    

Formal leadership experience in a similar context.

    

A Master’s degree in Engineering in a related technical field.

    

Strong ability to support and guide individuals based on their unique needs.

    

A strategic mindset and the ability to prioritize effectively in a complex environment.

    

Has strong communication skills in spoken and written English, Swedish is considered a big plus.

Why Join Silex?

At Silex, you’ll be part of one of the world’s leading MEMS foundries. Our technology enables innovation in a wide range of industries — from medical and automotive to telecommunications and consumer electronics. We offer a dynamic workplace with short decision paths, a diverse team of top talent, and exciting growth opportunities. Work-life balance matters at Silex, and we want our people to thrive in their careers as well as in life outside of work.

About the recruitment process  

We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile, and answer a few questions. 

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure a fair and objective assessment. If you progress through the full process, you will start with a digital interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners, followed by a personality and logical ability test. Next, you will meet with our VP of Product Development together with a Talent Acquisition Partner for an in-person interview, and finally with a Group Manager and our COO for final interviews. Before an offer, we also conduct reference checks, a background check, and a drug test. Randomized alcohol- and drug testing is conducted for all of our employees during the employment.
